name: byakugan
description: BYAKUGAN — a clean-room, extensible desktop companion for VALORANT.
author: Tyler

scripts.check: node --check src/main/index.cjs && node --check src/main/preload.cjs && node --check src/main/services/riot-client.cjs && node --check src/main/services/overlay-server.cjs && node --check src/main/services/remote-viewer-client.cjs && node --check src/main/services/update-service.cjs && node --check src/renderer/app.js && node --check src/overlay/overlay.js && node --check scripts/prepare-release.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-release.cjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/prepare-release.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config release-config.json --publish never && node scripts/verify-release.cjs
scripts.release:win: node scripts/prepare-release.cjs --require-feed && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config release-config.json --publish never && node scripts/verify-release.cjs --require-feed
